summary: Scheduler import remains expensive on the prepared ROCm stack: the first completed empty-private-cache subprocess took 28.612 s and compiled AIter core, while five warm-cache clean subprocesses averaged 13.086 s (12.868-13.217 s). Import profiling found an unnecessary eager quantization-to-MXFP4-to-AIter chain, plus OpenAI/FastAPI/torchvision imports. No source change was made because the measured fixes are already implemented in open upstream PRs #37602/#38005 and #38177; this PR avoids duplicating them.

tests.what_was_measured: First completed import against the initially empty private cache: 28.612 s wall; AIter module_aiter_core was compiled and loaded. Five later clean subprocesses with compiler/filesystem caches warm: mean 13.086 s, min 12.868 s, max 13.217 s.
Raw import profile retained at raw/importtime-before.log: Scheduler 11.059 s cumulative, quantization 5.287 s, AIter 4.773 s, and aiter.ops.flydsl.gemm_kernels 2.433 s self time.
Scheduler remained importable and resolved from the expected module; aiter, openai, fastapi, and torchvision were all present in sys.modules after import.
Recorded the single visible AMD Instinct MI350X and gfx950 environment for provenance only; this did not execute a GPU workload.

gpu_execution_evidence: No numerical GPU operation, model server, or kernel validation was required or run. ROCm SMI and torch device discovery were used only to identify the prepared host.
remaining_limitations: No source candidate was applied because matching lazy-import changes are already open upstream; therefore there is no before/after measurement for a new patch in this PR.
The host is shared and filesystem page cache, CPU scheduling, and concurrent workload state were not controlled. Warm samples are clean Python processes but use populated compiler/filesystem caches.

A sampling subprocess begun after the first completed run compiled module_rmsnorm_quant but was interrupted by the command runner; it is excluded from timing statistics, while its Ninja log is retained only as evidence of import-triggered compilation.
No serving behavior, model architecture, semantic accuracy, distributed workload, or numerical GPU path was tested because no runtime source behavior changed.
